description: Health of the data platform: CDC ingest rate and end-to-end latency per hop, dead letters, freshness of every pipeline stage, ClickHouse storage, and the high-frequency sensor-frame path.

panels.title: CDC row versions landed
panels.description: Row versions inserted into the three raw CDC tables in the range (inserts, updates, snapshot reads and deletes all land as versions; FINAL would collapse them, so it is not used here).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    (SELECT count() FROM raw_engine_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at))
  + (SELECT count() FROM raw_engine_status_registry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at))
  + (SELECT count() FROM raw_maintenance_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)) AS row_versions

panels.title: End-to-end latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of Postgres commit -> ClickHouse insert (ingested_at - cdc_source_ts) over every CDC row version that landed in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantile(0.95)(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ingested_at) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(cdc_source_ts)) / 1000
        AS latency_p95_s
    FROM
    (
        SELECT ingested_at, cdc_source_ts FROM raw_engine_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, cdc_source_ts FROM raw_engine_status_registry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, cdc_source_ts FROM raw_maintenance_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
    )

panels.title: Last CDC landing
panels.description: Seconds between the newest CDC row version in ClickHouse and the end of the range. The simulator commits every second, so anything above a few Spark trigger intervals (5 s) means a stalled hop.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT greatest(
               toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__toTime_ms) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(maxOrNull(ingested_at)),
               0) / 1000 AS since_last_landing_s
    FROM
    (
        SELECT ingested_at FROM raw_engine_telemetry WHERE ingested_at > $__toTime_ms - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ingested_at <= $__toTime_ms
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at FROM raw_engine_status_registry WHERE ingested_at > $__toTime_ms - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ingested_at <= $__toTime_ms
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at FROM raw_maintenance_log WHERE ingested_at > $__toTime_ms - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ingested_at <= $__toTime_ms
    )

panels.title: Dead-lettered records
panels.description: CDC records the streaming job could not parse in the range (raw_cdc_dead_letter). Anything above zero needs a look: the table below names the source and the error.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS dead_letters
FROM raw_cdc_dead_letter
WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)

panels.title: dbt gold build age
panels.description: Time since dbt last rebuilt the gold fleet board (fct_engine_health_status.refreshed_at). The orchestrator runs dbt every DBT_INTERVAL_SECONDS (120 s); a failed dbt test does not stop the build.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3)) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(max(refreshed_at))) / 1000 AS build_age_s
FROM fct_engine_health_status FINAL

panels.title: HF frames ingested
panels.description: High-frequency sensor frames (Avro, kHz vibration + process channels) reduced to features and inserted into ClickHouse in the range, from hf_ingest_batches. Zero until the HF path runs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(frames) AS frames
FROM hf_ingest_batches
WHERE $__timeFilter(batch_started_at)

panels.title: CDC ingestion (Postgres WAL -> Debezium -> Kafka -> Spark -> ClickHouse)
CDC ingest rate by source table
panels.description: Row versions per second landed in each raw table by ingested_at (inserts and updates; the registry is updated once per cycle, the maintenance log only at failures and repairs). Gaps are filled with zero so a stalled pipeline shows as a drop, not as missing data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, source, rows_per_second
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            $__timeInterval(ingested_at) AS time,
            source,
            count() / $__interval_s AS rows_per_second
        FROM
        (
            SELECT ingested_at, 'engine_telemetry' AS source FROM raw_engine_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, 'engine_status_registry' AS source FROM raw_engine_status_registry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, 'maintenance_log' AS source FROM raw_maintenance_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
        )
        GROUP BY time, source
        ORDER BY source, time WITH FILL
            FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, INTERVAL $__interval_s second)
            TO $__toTime
            STEP $__interval_s
    )
    ORDER BY time

panels.title: End-to-end CDC latency
panels.description: Commit -> ClickHouse latency of the row versions that landed in each bucket, split into capture (Postgres commit -> Debezium event, cdc_emitted_ts) and delivery (Kafka + the Spark micro-batch trigger + the ClickHouse insert).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
        $__timeInterval(ingested_at) AS time,
        quantile(0.5)(end_to_end_s) AS `commit -> ClickHouse p50`,
        quantile(0.95)(end_to_end_s) AS `commit -> ClickHouse p95`,
        max(end_to_end_s) AS `commit -> ClickHouse max`,
        quantile(0.95)(capture_s) AS `commit -> Debezium p95`
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ingested_at,
            (toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ingested_at) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(cdc_source_ts)) / 1000 AS end_to_end_s,
            (toUnixTimestamp64Milli(cdc_emitted_ts) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(cdc_source_ts)) / 1000 AS capture_s
        FROM
        (
            SELECT ingested_at, cdc_source_ts, cdc_emitted_ts FROM raw_engine_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, cdc_source_ts, cdc_emitted_ts FROM raw_engine_status_registry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, cdc_source_ts, cdc_emitted_ts FROM raw_maintenance_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
        )
    )
    GROUP BY time
    ORDER BY time

panels.title: CDC operations
panels.description: Debezium operation of every row version landed: inserts (c), updates (u: per-cycle registry progress and the back-flagging of a failed lifecycle's pulses), deletes (d) and initial-snapshot reads (r).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
        $__timeInterval(ingested_at) AS time,
        transform(cdc_op, ['c', 'u', 'd', 'r'], ['insert (c)', 'update (u)', 'delete (d)', 'snapshot (r)'],
                  concat('op ', cdc_op)) AS operation,
        count() AS row_versions
    FROM
    (
        SELECT ingested_at, toString(cdc_op) AS cdc_op FROM raw_engine_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, toString(cdc_op) AS cdc_op FROM raw_engine_status_registry WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ingested_at, toString(cdc_op) AS cdc_op FROM raw_maintenance_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
    )
    GROUP BY time, operation
    ORDER BY time

panels.title: Dead letters
panels.description: Unparseable CDC records per bucket (raw_cdc_dead_letter, 30-day TTL), zero-filled.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, dead_letters
FROM
(
    SELECT $__timeInterval(ingested_at) AS time, count() AS dead_letters
    FROM raw_cdc_dead_letter
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
    GROUP BY time
    ORDER BY time WITH FILL
        FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, INTERVAL $__interval_s second)
        TO $__toTime
        STEP $__interval_s
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Dead letters by source
panels.description: Dead-lettered records in the range per CDC source table (the last segment of the Kafka topic), with the newest error. Every source is listed, also at zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    source AS `Source`,
    sum(records) AS `Dead letters`,
    max(last_at) AS `Newest`,
    argMax(last_error, last_at) AS `Newest error`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        arrayJoin(['engine_telemetry', 'engine_status_registry', 'maintenance_log']) AS source,
        toUInt64(0) AS records,
        CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_at,
        '' AS last_error
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        splitByChar('.', kafka_topic)[-1] AS source,
        count() AS records,
        max(ingested_at) AS last_at,
        argMax(left(error, 200), ingested_at) AS last_error
    FROM raw_cdc_dead_letter
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
    GROUP BY kafka_topic
)
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY `Dead letters` DESC, source

panels.title: Freshness by pipeline stage
panels.description: Newest write of every hop, from the data itself: landing time of the raw CDC and HF tables, the raw watermark dbt has read into silver, feature/build times of the dbt models, the newest prediction and the newest training run. 'Expected within' is the age to expect at the default schedule (Spark 5 s, dbt 120 s, predictions after each dbt run, training every 30 min when new failures exist); the maintenance log is event-driven (it only moves on failures and repairs). NO DATA: nothing with an event time in the last 7 days (the HF path before it is deployed). The big tables are only scanned over their last 7 days of event time (monthly partitions, part min/max pruning).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    stage AS `Stage`,
    layer AS `Layer`,
    last_update AS `Newest write (UTC)`,
    (toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3)) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(last_update)) / 1000 AS `Age`,
    if(sla_s = 0, NULL, sla_s) AS `Expected within`,
    multiIf(last_update IS NULL, 'NO DATA', sla_s = 0, 'EVENT-DRIVEN',
            `Age` <= sla_s, 'OK', 'LATE') AS `Status`
FROM
(
    SELECT 1 AS ord, 'raw (CDC)' AS layer, 'raw_engine_telemetry' AS stage, toUInt32(60) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(ingested_at) FROM raw_engine_telemetry WHERE event_ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS ord, 'raw (CDC)' AS layer, 'raw_engine_status_registry' AS stage, toUInt32(60) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(ingested_at) FROM raw_engine_status_registry), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3 AS ord, 'raw (CDC)' AS layer, 'raw_maintenance_log' AS stage, toUInt32(0) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(ingested_at) FROM raw_maintenance_log), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4 AS ord, 'silver (dbt)' AS layer, 'stg_engine_telemetry (raw watermark)' AS stage, toUInt32(600) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(ingested_at) FROM stg_engine_telemetry WHERE event_ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 5 AS ord, 'silver (dbt)' AS layer, 'int_sensor_rolling_features' AS stage, toUInt32(600) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(feature_computed_at) FROM int_sensor_rolling_features WHERE event_ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 6 AS ord, 'gold (dbt)' AS layer, 'fct_engine_health_status' AS stage, toUInt32(600) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(refreshed_at) FROM fct_engine_health_status), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 7 AS ord, 'gold (dbt)' AS layer, 'rpt_model_live_performance' AS stage, toUInt32(600) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(refreshed_at) FROM rpt_model_live_performance), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 8 AS ord, 'serving' AS layer, 'gold_engine_rul_predictions' AS stage, toUInt32(600) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(predicted_at) FROM gold_engine_rul_predictions WHERE predicted_at > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 9 AS ord, 'ml' AS layer, 'ml_model_runs (training)' AS stage, toUInt32(7200) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(trained_at) FROM ml_model_runs), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 10 AS ord, 'hf' AS layer, 'raw_engine_hf_features' AS stage, toUInt32(60) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(ingested_at) FROM raw_engine_hf_features WHERE frame_start_ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 11 AS ord, 'hf' AS layer, 'hf_ingest_batches' AS stage, toUInt32(60) AS sla_s, CAST((SELECT maxOrNull(ingested_at) FROM hf_ingest_batches WHERE batch_started_at > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 'Nullable(DateTime64(3, \'UTC\'))') AS last_update
)
ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Storage footprint (active parts)
panels.description: On-disk size, rows, compression ratio and active part count of every table in the lakehouse database (system.parts). Many small active parts would point at too-frequent inserts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    table AS `Table`,
    sum(rows) AS `Rows`,
    sum(bytes_on_disk) AS `On disk`,
    sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) AS `Uncompressed`,
    round(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) / nullIf(sum(data_compressed_bytes), 0), 1) AS `Compression`,
    count() AS `Active parts`,
    max(modification_time) AS `Last part written`
FROM system.parts
WHERE database = currentDatabase()
  AND active
GROUP BY table
ORDER BY `On disk` DESC

panels.title: High-frequency path (Avro sensor frames -> Spark features -> ClickHouse)
HF throughput
panels.description: Frames and Avro payload volume per minute inserted by the clickhouse_hf_features query (hf_ingest_batches, one row per micro-batch). Laptop defaults: 6 engines x 1 frame/s, ~115 KB/s raw.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(batch_started_at) AS time,
    sum(frames) * 60 / $__interval_s AS `frames / min`,
    sum(bytes) * 60 / $__interval_s / 1000000 AS `MB / min`
FROM hf_ingest_batches
WHERE $__timeFilter(batch_started_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: HF micro-batch duration & frame lag
panels.description: Duration of each HF micro-batch (decode, FFT features, ClickHouse insert) and the lag from the newest frame of the batch to its insert. Backfilled frames (history generated on first boot) show as a large lag while they stream in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(batch_started_at) AS time,
    avg(duration_ms) / 1000 AS `batch duration avg`,
    max(duration_ms) / 1000 AS `batch duration max`,
    quantile(0.5)((toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ingested_at) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(max_frame_ts)) / 1000)
        AS `newest frame -> ClickHouse p50`
FROM hf_ingest_batches
WHERE $__timeFilter(batch_started_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: HF coverage per engine
panels.description: Every 1 Hz pulse should have one HF frame (frames are best-effort: the producer drops them when Kafka is unavailable, the CDC path stays lossless). Coverage = HF frames / current 1 Hz pulses in the range; missing frame_seq counts gaps in each engine's frame ordinal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    t.engine_id AS `Engine`,
    t.pulses AS `1 Hz pulses`,
    h.frames AS `HF frames`,
    h.frames / t.pulses AS `Coverage`,
    h.seq_gaps AS `Missing frame_seq`,
    if(h.frames = 0, NULL, h.newest_frame) AS `Newest frame`,
    h.payload_bytes AS `Avro payload`
FROM
(
    SELECT engine_id, count() AS pulses
    FROM raw_engine_telemetry FINAL
    WHERE is_deleted = 0
      AND $__timeFilter(event_ts)
    GROUP BY engine_id
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        uniqExact(telemetry_id) AS frames,
        max(frame_seq) - min(frame_seq) + 1 - uniqExact(frame_seq) AS seq_gaps,
        max(frame_start_ts) AS newest_frame,
        sum(frame_bytes) AS payload_bytes
    FROM raw_engine_hf_features FINAL
    WHERE $__timeFilter(frame_start_ts)
    GROUP BY engine_id
) AS h ON h.engine_id = t.engine_id
ORDER BY t.engine_id
